questions.question: How long does a station last on batteries when it measures every ten minutes?
questions.reference: About 14 months on two 18650 cells (accelerated simulation).
questions.answer: Piotr Zieliński reported in May that a station measuring every 10 minutes lasted **14 months** on two 18650 cells, but he noted this was an accelerated simulation, not a field test (Flux message in the "Czujniki" space, 2026-05-22). I found no later real-world measurement at 10 minutes. Field reports since then show batteries dropping to 5–20% at Zasp, Wrzeszcz and Przymorze, and firmware 2.5.0 sends data every 3 minutes, so the 14-month figure may not hold for the current firmware. If you need a reliable number, the sleep-current measurement you asked about earlier would be the thing to check.

input.q: battery station measures every ten minutes

judge.reason: The answer states the reference's key fact of about 14 months on two 18650 cells at 10-minute measurements and correctly notes it was an accelerated simulation, with the extra caveats not contradicting the reference.
